title: Sine Wave Parameter Explorer
description: A live sine plot with independent amplitude, frequency, and phase sliders, a color-matched equation readout, and a cosine overlay demonstrating the quarter-cycle relationship.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
Signals and Systems
Mathematics

educational.topic: Sine wave parameters: amplitude, frequency, phase
learningObjectives: Demonstrate which visual feature each of A, f, and phi controls
Calculate y(0) for given parameter values
prerequisites: The sine function on the unit circle
Reading a plot with labeled axes

controls.label: Overlay cosine wave
controls.purpose: Draw the same wave with phase pinned at 90 degrees

assumptions: A single pure sinusoid with no noise or damping
The plot is resampled per pixel column rather than at a fixed sample rate
limitations: Shows a continuous idealization; sampling and aliasing are covered separately in Chapter 6

keyQuestions: Which parameter changes peak spacing without changing peak height?
Why do the two curves coincide when phase is set to 90 degrees?
commonMisconceptions: That changing frequency also changes amplitude
That phase and frequency both 'move the wave sideways' in the same way
assessmentOpportunities: Identify the differing parameter between two waves given a described shift
